title: Great tour of palace and Jewish neighborhood
text: Isabel was great! She had history in the various areas and spent time with us explaining what we were seeing. Highly recommend!
author: Brett B

title: Highly Recommend for Families, Couples & Children
text: Isabel is absolutely wonderful and her English is excellent. We enjoyed this tour very much. Learning about the Royal Palace, the Jewish Quarter, and seeing the places where game of thrones was filmed in Sevilla was extremely interesting and fun. Highly recommend booking Isabel for tours if you are in Sevilla.
author: liznitzvlasicak

title: Trip to Sevilla
text: Isabel was fantastic on our family tour! She took us to Royal Palace Alcazar and to the Jewish Quarter Isabel is extremely informative and really made my first trip to Spain a special experience! I would recommend her to anyone visiting and look forward to having her as a tour guide again in the future.
author: T172SMjennyf

title: Perfect morning visit to the Alcazar and Jewish Quarter with Isabel
text:
I have used Isabel as a tour guide a few times over the past few years when friends or family have visited and never been disappointed. This visit was no different, as several family members were visiting Sevilla for my son’s  wedding, and it made for a perfect morning visit with Isabel to the Royal Palace(Alcazar) of Sevilla and to the Jewish Quarter (Barrio de Santa Cruz).
She is extremely knowledgeable and informed, and you feel like you really have learned so much from her in a personal way, that you cannot do on your own or in a huge tour group.

title: New looks
text:
I thought I already knew Seville well in general and, specifically, the Alcázar had previously visited and also the Santa Cruz neighborhood, but with Isabel as a guide it was like discovering colors, figures and new landscapes in a painting that was familiar and we thought we knew well.
It made me think of a Leonard Cohen song: "Now, Suzanne takes your hand and she leads you to the river. And she shows you where to look among the garbage and the flowers ...
